title: Up to the castle
steps: The last seal is broken, and the road to the castle is open.
We did it! We really did it together!
We did so much today, from taking that first step when we learned a program is a list of instructions, to seeing you are an object the code calls `wizard` and your actions are methods!

On the long path, you used an argument to tell your move exactly how far to go, and when we found the note with the wrong move, we saw a comment is just a note for a person. Finally, you used `say` to speak the password *ambrel* as a string, which keeps words exactly as written in quotes, before using `pick_up` to grab the wand and casting the spell *zelim* to break the seal!
Thank you for all your help, Nuri. Casting that spell with the wand was my favourite part!

The wand is only lent. Ilda, our teacher, waits inside, and the wand bank, a counter in the castle run by the pupils' parents, lends every new pupil a school wand for the year; then you can give my spare one back.
You walk up the road together. The castle's windows are lit, and the great doors wait for you. The real castle begins.
